shortDescription: Query logs from a specified DNS app on Technitium DNS server

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: class_path
options.description: The class path of the DNS app

options.name: client_ip_address
options.description: The client IP address to filter the logs

options.name: descending_order
options.description: Orders the selected data set in descending order

options.name: end
options.description: The end date time in ISO 8601 format to filter the logs

options.name: entries_per_page
options.description: The number of entries per page

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the installed DNS app

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended When unspecified, the current node is used This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: page_number
options.description: The page number of the data set to retrieve

options.name: protocol
options.description: The DNS transport protocol to filter the logs

options.name: qclass
options.description: The DNS class (QCLASS) in the request question section to filter the logs

options.name: qname
options.description: The query name (QNAME) in the request question section to filter the logs

options.name: qtype
options.description: The DNS resource record type (QTYPE) in the request question section to filter the logs

options.name: rcode
options.description: The DNS response code to filter the logs

options.name: response_type
options.description: The DNS server response type to filter the logs

options.name: start
options.description: The start date time in ISO 8601 format to filter the logs

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
